title: TITLE: SAVES BLOCK AS WIDE AS THE MODES, NAME BOX LOWER CASE
why: The critic scored the title 3 of 5: the saves block was 898px wide under a 558px mode column and the name box showed PILLAGER in capitals. The block is the menu width and the default name is lower case.
now: The saves block lines up with the mode buttons and the name box is lower case.

edits.replacement: #root #slotpanel{ max-width:var(--menu-w); margin-left:auto; margin-right:auto; }   /* v28.xx (cw-title-saves), the critic on screen 01 (3 of 5): "the saves block is 898px wide under a 558px mode column". One column: the saves block is as wide as the mode buttons (--menu-w). */

window.titleNameShown=function(n){ return n==='PILLAGER'?'pillager':n; };   // v28.xx (cw-title-saves), the critic on screen 01 (P0): the name box showed PILLAGER in capitals, and every word on screen is lower case (his order 2026-10-18). Only the default name is lowered; a name he typed keeps its letters.
    if(pin) pin.value=titleNameShown(P.pname||'');
if(_nv&&_nv!==P.pname&&_nv!==titleNameShown(P.pname)){ P.pname=_nv; saveProfile(); }   // v28.xx (cw-title-saves): the lowered default is not a new name
